test: Armbian family write_uboot_platform on a Linux build host with a disposable sparse file and its loop device
positive: Matching source U-Boot, exact fixed GPT and matched Linux loop mapping
Both payloads read back byte-for-byte at their respective LBAs
Primary GPT, compatibility mirror, backup GPT and root partition sentinel preserved
Second invocation succeeded with the same bytes
negative: Default Armbian partition configuration rejected before image creation
Wrong standalone U-Boot rejected with both boot slots still empty
Corrupt compatibility GPT mirror rejected with both boot slots still empty
remaining: The public Armbian board definition still needs a partition creation hook that generates the matching layout and an integrated U-Boot configuration that reproduces the package. This test did not build or boot a complete image.
